description: Implementation of ResourceManager11 class for managing D3D11 resources, including resource creation, memory tracking, and cleanup functions within ANGLE project.

classes.name: ResourceManager11
classes.description: Manages D3D11 resources, handles creation, memory accounting, and cleanup.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a D3D11 resource, optionally initializes and clears it.

methods.name: incrResource
methods.description: Increments resource count and memory usage tracking.

methods.name: decrResource
methods.description: Decrements resource count and memory usage tracking.

methods.name: onReleaseGeneric
methods.description: Handles resource release and updates memory tracking.

methods.name: createInitDataIfNeeded
methods.description: Creates initial data for textures if needed, based on description.

methods.name: setAllocationsInitialized
methods.description: Sets whether resource allocations are initialized.
